narrative.details:
If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.  He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.

But I wouldn't hope.  Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead.  Or if he's undead he probably no longer cares about Deliah.
narrative.objectives: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
narrative.offerRewardText:
A Deliah did live in Brill not long ago. She was buried in the mass grave but if what you say is true, then the Rot Hide Gnolls must have stolen her body and taken it to Silverpine.

The Rot Hides, like all the Scourge, must be destroyed. I trust you are taking steps to make that happen.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello, adventurer. What brings you back to Brill?

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 14 to 20, 4,840 XP in all.

quests.name: The Dead Fields
quests.objectiveText: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields. When Nightlash appears, kill her. Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: The Decrepit Ferry
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Decrepit Ferry. Search for the reason the Scourge are there.

quests.name: Rot Hide Clues
quests.objectiveText: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: The Engraved Ring
quests.objectiveText: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

quests.name: A Husband's Revenge
quests.objectiveText: Kill Valdred Moray. Bring his hands to Raleigh Andrean in the Undercity.
